description: Explicit CPU float32 consumer profiles. Model binaries are external inputs; profile support does not constitute model-quality or release acceptance.

models.title: SqueezeNet 1.1 (trained Model Zoo)
models.source_note: The source hash identifies the trained ONNX file: input data [1,3,224,224], output squeezenet0_flatten0_reshape0 [1,1000]. The final node is Reshape; no Softmax is present. The old ONNX light test fixture is excluded.

models.title: ResNet50 v1 (ONNX Model Zoo)
models.source_note: Original trained ONNX Model Zoo ResNet50 v1, opset 12. Input data binds symbolic batch N to 1; output resnetv17_dense0_fwd is [1,1000]. No ONNX rewrite or added softmax. Direct square resize with the declared RGB normalization; upstream benchmark equivalence is not claimed.

models.title: YOLO11n classification
models.source_note: Prospective export of the pinned official YOLO11n classification checkpoint, SHA-256 c62d41bf9625777760018bf914d2e6cd472420ccd01706d97a61cb6c82502bd7, using Ultralytics 8.4.146, CPU FP32, batch 1, opset 17 and no simplifier. Output output0 is [1,1000]; this profile adds no mean/std or extra softmax. Original model terms and exporter source accompany the source pack; the own helper's MIT notice does not replace upstream terms.

models.title: YOLO11n detection

models.title: RT-DETR R18vd detection
models.source_note: Prospective export of PekingU/rtdetr_r18vd at the recorded revision; model.safetensors SHA-256 fe87a5a30f5daf298d10794c7682a63b6107986f97d6a770ba948d89e4340093. Transformers 4.45.2, CPU FP32, batch 1 and opset 17 produce logits [1,300,80] and normalized pred_boxes [1,300,4]. Best class per query, sigmoid once, threshold 0.3. This adapter does not apply NMS; the numeric nms_threshold is an unused catalogue field.
